lines.text: Cloudflare now lets the internet reach private apps without exposing them.
Internal tools, like internal APIs and AI agent backends, were never built to face the internet.
lines.title: Apps behind the wall

lines.text: Before, letting outsiders in often meant poking holes in firewalls.
lines.title: Old way vs new way

lines.text: Visitors reach Cloudflare first. Cloudflare then passes the request on to the private app.
lines.title: The new path

lines.text: Cloudflare's usual protections apply automatically, like the web firewall, bot checks, rate limits and caching.
lines.title: Protections included

lines.text: Private-to-private connections are not supported yet. A closed beta is aimed for early 2027.
lines.title: What is missing

lines.text: Teams can share private services safely without opening their firewalls.
lines.title: Takeaways
